anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Smooth, uniform convexity with a moderate radius curve transitioning from the blowhole region toward the rostrum.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a low length-to-thickness ratio; the visible length from the inflection point is approximately equal to the base width.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle of approximately 155 degrees at the point where the melon curve intersects the dorsal line of the rostrum.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct white, rectangular artificial tag is attached to the anterior margin of the right pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Notably elongated and slender pectoral fins exhibiting a sharp ventral curvature toward the distal tips; faint dark pigmentation spots are visible on the lateral body wall posterior to the pectoral fin.
